Chipotle Order Turns Into Full WWE Match After Guy Allegedly Storms Behind Counter Over Extra Meat
Audio By Carbonatix
A routine Chipotle order turned into absolute chaos after a customer allegedly lost his mind over extra meat and ended up behind the counter, confronting employees in a wild viral video blowing up online.
The clip starts off like any normal Chipotle experience, people waiting in line, workers building bowls at lightning speed, somebody probably debating whether guac is worth the extra charge. Then everything completely derails.
According to people sharing the footage, the situation started when a woman wearing a headscarf began arguing with employees over portion sizes and demanded extra meat for her order. Things escalated fast after the man with her, described online as the “varsity jacket guy,” stepped in and started aggressively confronting workers behind the counter.
Instead of calming things down, the guy apparently decided the best possible move was to physically go behind the serving line himself.
At that point, the entire restaurant basically transforms from “fast casual dining” into “live police bodycam footage.”
Video shows the man getting directly into an employee’s space and allegedly putting hands on the worker while stunned customers look on. Employees appear completely caught off guard as the argument spirals into a full scene over what internet commenters are calling “the most expensive scoop of chicken in human history.”
